Free Home Improvement Calculators

  • Concrete Slab Calculator – Free concrete calculator: enter slab length, width and thickness to get cubic yards, cubic feet and the number of 40, 60 or 80 lb bags needed.
  • Room Paint Calculator – Estimate gallons of paint for a room: enter wall dimensions, doors, windows and coats. Uses 350–400 sq ft per gallon coverage.
  • Mulch Calculator – Calculate how much mulch you need: bed area and depth to cubic yards and 2 or 3 cubic foot bags.
  • Gravel Calculator – Gravel calculator for driveways, paths and patios: get cubic yards and tons from length, width and depth.
  • Tile Calculator – Tile calculator for floors and walls: enter area and tile size to get tile count and boxes, with waste for cuts.
